tiers.label: excellent
tiers.meaning: AI engines can lift answers from this page with almost no rewriting.

tiers.label: good
tiers.meaning: Most passages are quotable as-is; a few sections still need context to stand alone.

tiers.label: fair
tiers.meaning: An engine can find an answer here, but it has to reassemble it from several places.

tiers.label: weak
tiers.meaning: Answers exist on the page but are buried in context that does not travel.

tiers.label: poor
tiers.meaning: There is little here an engine can quote without inventing the surrounding meaning.
